title: TRICARE Prime Amounts Credited to the TRICARE Select Family Catastrophic Total - Corrected Stays
content:
A beneficiary who changed from TRICARE Prime to **TRICARE Select** during the plan year carries the amounts credited toward the Prime catastrophic cap into the Select family catastrophic total of a corrected stay. The TRICARE Prime records read are the beneficiary's Prime enrollment (its status, effective date and end date), its claim lines (cost shares and point-of-service flags) and their reversals, and its fee charges and payments.

**Provision.** Where the beneficiary changed from TRICARE Prime to this Select enrollment during the plan year (the Prime enrollment ended by the beneficiary's own choice on the day before Select took effect), the amounts already credited toward the Prime catastrophic cap are credited to the family catastrophic total of a corrected stay. Within this rule's scope the beneficiary's only Prime enrollment took effect in the plan year, so every Prime record belongs to that calendar plan year, and the Prime amounts are: the cost shares on the beneficiary's Prime claim lines other than point-of-service charges, less the cost shares withdrawn by Prime reversals, plus the Prime enrollment fees paid toward the Prime installments whose coverage period has begun (the Prime payments posted, never more than those installments, payments being applied oldest first). Where those Prime amounts reach the tier's family catastrophic cap, the cap itself is credited; where the beneficiary changed from Prime in that way and they fall short of it, those Prime amounts are credited; otherwise nothing is credited from Prime. Point-of-service charges, premium-based plan costs and amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount never count toward the total.

## What counts as a change from TRICARE Prime

| Prime enrollment record | Change from Prime? |
|---|---|
| disenrolled by the beneficiary's own choice, last day the day before the Select effective date | yes |
| disenrolled by the beneficiary's own choice, ending earlier than the day before the Select effective date | no |
| ended for nonpayment, ineligibility or transfer | no |
| no Prime enrollment | no |

## Caps the Prime amounts are compared with

| Tier | Family catastrophic cap (US dollars) |
|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 1000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 1000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 1252.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 1252.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 3000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 4034.00 |

## Hypothetical credits (TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, cap 3000.00)

- Prime ended by choice on 2026-03-31, Select effective 2026-04-01; Prime cost shares 900.00 of which 100.00 point-of-service, 50.00 withdrawn by a Prime reversal, Prime fees paid 400.00 on begun installments of 350.00: 800.00 less 50.00 plus 350.00, so 1100.00 is credited.
- The same change with Prime amounts of 3200.00: 3000.00, the cap, is credited.
